notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1.1
notes.content: [p]Greetings, mighty FantasyCrafters![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for testing our new update and for submitting your bug reports on Steam and Discord. We’ve addressed several issues and implemented a few quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Quality-of-Life Improvements:[/p][p]• Mana Potions: Increased the amount of mana in mana potions.[/p][p]• Bow Aiming: The bow now has an aim feature.[/p][p]• Arrow Count Display: When holding your bow, the quantity of arrows left in your inventory is shown in the bottom-right corner.[/p][p]• Digging XP Adjustments: XP from digging is now divided into three stages based on the size of the dug pile.[/p][p]• Shortcut Added: Ledges have been placed near the river on the left side of the stone fence via cemetery, providing a shortcut to the clay deposit.[/p][p]• Forest Golem Buff: Increased the Forest Golem’s armor.[/p][p]• Forest Golem XP: Added XP rewards for defeating the Forest Golem.[/p][p]• Crafting Speed: Reduced the crafting time for ropes.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]• Blueprint Sales: Fixed an issue where traders sold two copies of blueprints.[/p][p]• Ledge Climbing: Resolved the problem preventing players from climbing ledges in Mekhrahn’s dungeon.[/p][p]• Waterfall Shortcut: Fixed the non-functional shortcut button in the Waterfall Cave.[/p][p]• Collision Issues: Adjusted collisions in the Waterfall Cave.[/p][p]• Skeleton Helmets: Removed stuck Rusty Skeleton helmets to prevent game-breaking issues.[/p][p]• Fountain Sound: Added sound effects for the fountain in the marketplace.[/p][p]• Selling Items: Players can now sell refined short swords.[/p][p]• Feather XP Exploit: Fixed infinite XP gain from feathers in nests.[/p][p]• Multiplayer Teleportation: Clients no longer teleport with the host if they are not in the game.[/p][p]• Enemy Detection: Reduced the trigger range of enemies.[/p][p]• Stefania’s Shop Update: Stefania now purchases new plants and mana potions.[/p][p]• Maximilian’s Shop Update: Maximilian now purchases legendary tools.[/p][p]• Firewood Usage: Fixed an issue where miners did not use firewood.[/p][p]• Miners’ Auto-Shutdown: Resolved the problem causing miners to turn off automatically.[/p][p]• Door Visual Bug: Fixed a multiplayer issue where clients saw closed doors visually but could still pass through them.[/p][p]• Texture Fix: Fixed the algae textures.[/p][p]• Building Fix: Fixed incorrect crafting of left and right triangle walls.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/dcde4b200f5cf3d0eb5023ee7c9f8456db649d8f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 0.2.1.0
notes.content: [p]Greetings, mighty FantasyCrafters![/p][p]The moment you’ve been waiting for has arrived—[b]Magisterium: Fantasy Craft[/b] is about to get even more EPIC with a [b]massive new update[/b]! Buckle up, because we’re diving deep into magic, mayhem, and legendary loot.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Quest Alert: Estefalia’s Bangle[/b][/p][p]We’ve finished this quest and now you get two stunning new locations to explore. But that’s just the beginning…[/p][p][b]A Taste of Magic (Before School’s in Session!)[/b][/p][p]The School of Magic isn’t ready yet (patience, young apprentice), but we’re sprinkling in some basic arcane goodness to keep your daily adventures spellbinding! Get ready for:[/p][p]·       New plants (for brewing wicked mana potions)[/p][p]·       Magic scrolls (because who needs torches when you can cast Lumos Revelio?)[/p][p]·       Basic magic rings (because every hero needs a little bling)[/p][p]·       New enemies (to test your combat skills)[/p][p]·       A fearsome mini-boss (with legendary loot up for grabs!)[/p][p] [/p][p]New Content Breakdown:[/p][p]New locations[/p][p]·       River in the canyon with a tiny cave[/p][p]·       Waterfall Cave (home to creepy-crawly new foes)[/p][p]·       Mysterious cave in the Big Forest (because every forest needs secrets)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/ce0fd5e6c253dcad289fd58400e6c7d6d3264f16.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/eaf9386ca2151432457b11dbf4600e7e9da608e6.png"][/img][/p][p]   New enemies:[/p][p]·       Cave Bugs (annoying but squishable)[/p][p]·       Black Widow Spiders (nope, nope, nope)[/p][p]·       Mini-boss: Forest Golem (smash him for [b]legendary tools![/b])[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/68e6846d45316b32bd2e38121ef8587662c46f3c.png"][/img][/p][p]New blueprints:[/p][p]·       Blueprint of a large leather bag (you get +24 more slots and + 300 max weight - hoarders rejoice!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/10b0dd667dbfd92146bf0b6c3ad5439448dd5994.png"][/img][/p][p]·       Blueprint of a large cooling box (more space + [b]dry ice/ice[/b] = fresh loot forever)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/ed640f30d390a577764efa911e8c2c9f4c2f8d6f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]New Plants (Brew ‘Em Up!):[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]·       Zephyr’s Breath Algae (found near the Cave Waterfall)[/p][p]·       Arcanecap Mushroom (lurking in the Magic Forest and some caves, check the mysterious cave in the Big Forest)[/p][p]·       Silentium Flower (hidden in the Ruins)[/p][p] [/p][p]As a fun experiment, we’re rolling out basic magic early! While the School of Magic is still under construction, we’ll periodically add scrolls and other mystical goodies to let you dabble in the arcane.[/p][p]Magic (potions, magic scrolls, rings):[/p][p]Mana Potions (we enabled Intelligence option in the Attributes for you to boost up your mana):[/p][p]·       Morningdew Mana Potion – Adds 5 mana points. Made from Zypher’s Breath Algae.[/p][p]·       Moonshroud Mana Potion – Adds 10 mana points. Made from Arcanecap Mushroom.[/p][p]·       Wealdwell Mana Potion – Adds 15 mana points. Made from Silentium Flowers.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/4ec8bad125b67081c520974072456182bd326030.png"][/img][/p][p]Magic Scrolls (visit Joshua and Efelzaal for fresh stock):[/p][p]·       Lumos Revelio Scroll (bye-bye, torches and portable lamp!)[/p][p]·       Healing Scroll (because bandages are so last season)[/p][p]·       Fire Arrow Scroll (enemies hate this one trick)[/p][p]·       Gatherer’s Eye Scroll (highlights the items on the ground beside you)[/p][p]Magic Rings (craft ‘em at an anvil—Fred’s got the blueprints!):[/p][p]·       Minor Mana Ring (adds overall mana +5)[/p][p]·       Vitality Ring (adds overall health +5)[/p][p](Pro tip: Rings can break, so keep an [b]Advanced Repair Tool Kit[/b] handy!)[/p][p] [/p][p]New gear and mechanics:[/p][p]·       Rusty Skeleton’s Helmet (+5 armor, looted from Skeletons)[/p][p]·       Bleeding mechanic from strong enemies (lasts for 60 seconds) - stock up on bandages or Wipe your tears away potions to stop bleeding.[/p][p] [/p][p]Quality of Life Upgrades:[/p][p]1)      Weapons buffs: Refined Short Sword (+30 dmg), Iron Morning Star (+25 dmg)[/p][p]2)      Ice melts slower, lamps burn oil slower (sustainability!)[/p][p]3)      Simple vials, places and cups return after use (no more wasted tableware)[/p][p]4)      Skeleton gear (Skeleton bows, Skeleton Rusty Swords and Rusty Skeleton Helmets) (Maximilian and Fred are buying)[/p][p]5)      Blueprint of a Big Bottle Mold has been removed from Fred’s goods and added to a list of blueprints in the Damned Place[/p][p]6)      The selling price of Watering cans at Adriano has been increased[/p][p]7)      Now Fred buys rare and epic tools[/p][p]8)      The swimming mechanic has been improved (hold [b]Shift[/b] to dive/rise faster)[/p][p]9)      Enemies’ damage has been revamped (now poisonous enemies don’t inject poison with every bite) – don’t forget to use Anaconda’s kiss antidote potion to neutralize poison.[/p][p]10)   Decreased the quantity of mushrooms needed to craft Wipe your tears potion (now it takes 3 mushrooms to craft it instead of 4)[/p][p]11)   Warg is back to the Ruins (did you miss him? …Did you?)[/p][p] [/p][p]We’ve rebalanced Vitality and Endurance attributes:[/p][p]·       Vitality now grants +5 HP per point.[/p][p]·       Endurance now provides +5 Stamina per point.[/p][p]In future updates, as we introduce new armor sets, rings, and weapons, these values may be adjusted downward to +2 per point to maintain game balance.[/p][p]Bugs fixed:[/p][p]·       Fixed [b]boiled egg prices[/b] (no more egg scams!)[/p][p]·       Fixed the bug when Steward could buy dishes, Fonzy can buy new dishes.[/p][p]·       Recipe scrolls can no longer be sold (oops)[/p][p]·       Lift button panel added in Engineer’s Settlement[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]We want to remind you again not to neglect the upgrading of your Attributes especially Strength, because some enemies are now [b]deadlier than ever[/b]. [b]So upgrade your Strength[/b] and gear up before tackling cursed zones![/p][p]Remember:[/p][p]·       Skill points are both for Skills and for Attributes![/p][p]·       Gain XP by questing, crafting, farming and slaying[/p][p]·       [b]The grind never stops[/b] (but rewards get sweeter!)[/p][p] [/p][p]You’ll never stop earning skill points, no matter your level. However, each new level will require more XP to progress.[/p][p]Higher-level players can boost their mana by wearing mana rings. Also, don’t forget: the Bizarre Amulet grants additional mana too![/p][p]Now go forth, craft, conquer, and unleash the magic![/p][p]Your Magisterium Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes:

Fixed an issue where quest items could be accidentally sold (they’re now properly protected).

notes.title: Small Update & Bug Fixes – Patch v 0.2.0.8
notes.content:
Hello, dear FantasyCrafters!

As requested, we’ve added a small new location with additional coal, iron, and copper deposits! You’ll find it inside Emperor Mehkrahn’s underground palace, hidden behind wooden gates—break them down with any weapon to access the riches. We’ve also squashed some pesky bugs and made tweaks.

Here’s what’s new in this patch:

• New mini-location – Extra coal, iron, and ore deposits added.

• Window bug fixed

• Increased the map box

• Skeletons in the Ruins buffed – Fight smarter, warriors!

• Increased arrow stack size – Carry more ammo.

• Fixed Pierre’s quest reward – Now correctly gives lockpicks for "The Family Ring" quest.

• Added missing translations – German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.

• Stone-tier building upgrade removed (this was a test).

• Milk bottles now auto-stack – Inventory management made easier.

• Adjusted cow milking time – Slightly longer for realism.

• Combat tweak – Attack animations can now be canceled into a block.

notes.title: Small fix 0.2.0.6
notes.content:
Hello, our dear magisteris!
We’ve addressed several issues based on your reports and added some quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed chicks not dying when their hunger reached 0.
• Fixed hunger not saving properly for domestic animals.
• Fixed getting stuck behind the bench in the Engineer’s Settlement library.
• Fixed incorrect slot quantity after respawn (related to clothing).
• Fixed the portable lamp disappearing after death and duplicating in combat.
• Fixed ore and crystal nodes disappearing after mining.
• Fixed an infinite XP exploit when collecting items placed on the hotbar.
Quality-of-Life Improvements:
• Increased stack sizes for:
• Carcasses
• Bones
• Guts
• Seeds
• Increased coal burning time to 50 seconds.
Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Small fix 0.2.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, our dear magisteris!
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone playing our game, we really appreciate it! A special thanks to those who reported bugs and helped improve the experience.
This update addresses the following issues:
• Removed version/bug text that appeared under saved games
• Fixed the problem that prevented cattle from eating/drinking.
• Corrected swimming mechanics where rapid surfacing wasn't working
• Resolved missing wooden angular pillar in constructor's bench
• Boosted cotton yield from farming.
• Gamma settings now only affect in-game visuals
Your feedback continues to shape the game – please keep reporting any issues you encounter!

notes.title: Small Fix 0.2.0.3
notes.content:
Hello, our dear magisteris!

We’d like to thank every one of you who plays—and replays—our game, reports bugs, and helps us improve! Your support means the world to us. It keeps us going and inspires us to do better!
In this update, we’ve fixed several issues you reported:
• Removed the Tannery blueprint from the Blueprints section (oops, spoiler!).
• Added a barrier to the druid circle in the Magic Forest to prevent access to restricted areas.
• Adjusted Portalsteins’ respawn time.
• Fixed the portable lamp.
• Resolved the issue preventing the use of rare and epic tools/knives.
• Patched the infinite XP exploit with feathers—they no longer respawn unless the game is restarted.
• Fixed the bug causing workbenches to change types (e.g., Constructor’s → Coal Miner, Clay Miner → Copper Miner) when picked up.
• Fixed crouching mechanics and added a crouch toggle in Settings (default: Left Ctrl).
• Added a Gamma slider in Settings.

For those of you who play in multiplayer and encounters the problem with the lights not turning on at night, please go to settings uncheck the Day/Night cycle, apply, then check Day/Night cycle and apply again. It’s a temporary solution, we’ll implement a permanent fix soon.
Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm!

notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.content: We've fixed the bug causing infinite feather spawns in certain locations. We've also repaired the terrain in the cave within the Big Forest. Thanks to everyone who reports bugs! We're addressing them promptly.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:
We have noticed that after the release of Update 0.2.0.1 (31.03.2025), some players have reported issues such as duplicated items, cloned NPCs, duplicated terrain chunks, etc. This indicates that you have loaded an old save file. As previously mentioned, starting a new game is required after installing this update.

While you may attempt to continue using old saves, you will inevitably encounter problems that prevent further progression. For the best experience, we strongly recommend that all players begin a fresh game.

This requirement is necessary due to fundamental changes in the game's architecture that could not be implemented while maintaining backward compatibility.

Fixed Issues:

Torches were being crafted with 50% durability – fixed

Russian localization was not loading – fixed

notes.title: Major Update 0.2
notes.content:
New Major Update is out now

Greetings, dear FantasyCrafters!

We’re thrilled to finally roll out a major new update—packed with exciting features and fresh adventures! A huge thank you to each of you for your patience and unwavering support. You’re the best! 

Before diving in, a quick heads-up:
• If you’re planning to play with friends, we highly recommend exploring the storyline together and unlocking locations as a team—it’s way more fun that way!
• Our game has a brand-new name: Magisterium: Fantasy Craft! Why? Well, "Fantasy Craft" kept getting mixed up with Minecraft mods (sigh), and we wanted something truly unique that fits the game’s lore. Plus, as the story unfolds, you’ll see even more magical elements woven into the world!
• Pro tip for farmers: Before buying eggs or cattle, make sure you’ve got enough wheat and corn to whip up some chickenfeed and cattlefeed. Hungry animals = unhappy farm!

New content galore:
1. A grand new quest kicks off the game’s storyline—starting with Governor Estiel. Adventure awaits!
2. Fresh locations with new blueprints to discover. Time to explore!
3. Travel portals now link all key spots: New location, Mekhrahn’s Palace (mine), Wolfish Hollow, Big Forest, Magic Forest, Damned Place, Elefin’s Ruined Palace.
How to use them? 
Repair with a technological repair kit, craft your own portal at the engineering table, and fuel it with processed portalsteins. Just put a processed portalstein into Required items slot, after the portal is activated, chose a place you want to travel to, press craft, step inside the portal and get ready to be teleported.
Pro tip: Always carry extra fuel!
Warning: Teleporting with friends? Everyone hops along—this helps reduce server load. Teamwork makes the dream work!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/f1ea2aaebdc4027c9b9e8b52e1dabfb8f3d3bb4f.png[/img]

4. Portalstein – a shiny new mineral powering portals (and future tech—stay tuned!).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/e55a52b93d8f25fe4ca83a08358d967dd955bffa.png[/img]

5. Technological repair kit – your go-to for fixing fancy gadgets. Grab the blueprint in a new location.
6. Engineering table – will help you to craft a technological repair kit, a travel portal and to process portalsteins. Study the blueprint in a new location.
7. Rock-salt miner – digs up rock salt, alumstones, and mineral soil. Place it on deposits in Wolfish Hollow. Blueprint available in a new location.
8. Clay-soil miner – harvests clay and soil. Perfect for your homestead! Blueprint found in a new location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/3252a2f236d72e82a60b23057e13f96d626c3533.png[/img]

9. Grindstone – upgrade tools to rare (70% chance) or epic (45% chance). But beware—failure means losing materials. High risk, high reward!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/e32559c826e52241161e43b809e7d87a1a4548ad.png[/img]

10. New weapons!
• Iron morning star. Buy from Fred.
• Refined short sword -study in the ruins.
11. Metal alloy parts – new crafting tier!
12. Steles system—no more digging through locked chests! Now, blueprints, manuals, keys, and artifacts are neatly placed on steles for easy studying.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/6e3645fdbaa29d57a37f303bfd51aca2e4b19847.png[/img]

13. Lockpicking skill— is added into your skill table unlocks at level 10. Master all three levels, and chests will bow before you!
14. Crusher—grind stone into sand! Complete Estiel’s 3rd quest to get it ASAP.
15. Expanded building area—now with more space for your dream farm, house, and garden!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/8790d276b905c5509acb0cc02d997f4db18491fd.png[/img]

16. Iron, coal and copper deposits have been deleted from - Mekhrahn’s mine now holds iron, coal, and copper deposits (where they belong).
17. Primitive building is here! Craft thatch parts from your inventory using sticks, fiber, and ropes. Need long sticks? Chop logs at a stump! Upgrade to wood later if you like.
Farm life just got cuter!
18. Roosters, hens, and chicks—oh my!
• Hens lay eggs (add a rooster for fertilized ones).
• Kill a hen/rooster? Get poultry carcasses (dress them at the butcher’s block) and feathers.
• Buy eggs/roosters from Sebastian, build a hatchery, and incubate eggs for chicks.
• Use chickenfeed to make them follow you. Aww!

19. Wicker fences & gates—buy blueprints from Eugene. Build fences for your poultry and cattle!
Pro tip: Fence don’t attach to each other so please use grid attachment (Alt) for perfect alignment!
20. Cows, Bulls and Calves: 
• A cow gives milk. When you see the full milk indicator, approach the cow with a small empty bottle to collect milk.
• Cows can give birth to calves, but you'll need a bull for breeding.
• If you kill a cow or bull, you'll receive a premium carcass that can be processed at the butcher's block.
• Killing a calf yields a small carcass.
• Want your cattle to follow you? Simply feed them cattlefeed!

21. Chickenfeed and Cattlefeed. These recipes can be bought from Sebastian. Chickenfeed and Cattlefeed is cooked in the cook’s stove.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/4adcee78de9a0103c4e8eb68178d7f83c4ecded3.png[/img]

22. Feeders & troughs (chickenfeeder, poultry water trough, cattlefeeder, cattle water trough)—keep your animals happy. Blueprints from Eugene.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/1114743dcebfb07d4151efd02251aa1c35cf2eb7.png[/img]

New Dishes & Handy Tweaks
23. Yummy new recipes (buy from Claudia): boiled egg, fried eggs, fried eggs with frankfurters, village bread, roasted chicken leg, fried chicken wings, braised chicken breast with vegetables, simple started culture and village cheese Firefly. Cheese is made in the dryer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/adb4a7fed94b254cf6c70356ee5e2667977c84b7.png[/img]

24. Cotton seeds—now drop when harvesting cotton. Grow your own!
25. Climbing & crouching—scale walls and stairs in special spots. Sneaky!
26. Improved maps—scrollable and interactive! Keep one in your inventory and press M to check your location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/a1172f1a355db2a0e96ee42bb41299156e941e57.png[/img]

27. Notes have been transferred into a separate section —press N to access. No more clutter!
28. Skeletons now wield skeleton’s rusty swords—no more arrow swords!
29. The Valley of Stone Giants (in Ruins) has been closed temporary and will be opened to you very soon to bring you another piece of the story of the game. 
Quality-of-Life Improvements:
30. Loading screen tips—handy hints while you wait!
31. Workbench guides—clearer instructions.
32. Revamped workbench interfaces—smoother crafting.
33. Revamped building system – the distance building is increased, now the building parts are being highlighted, you can pick up all your building parts.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/4f72aa1e5ff843477bf6706b37a3bbb8e0c7c34b.png[/img]

34. Bigger stacks! 
• Simple Vials/simple water vials; big cant timber and small blocking lumber; ice; wooden flat plates, wooden soup plates and wooden cups; copper, iron and golden plates - now stack to 100. Less inventory stress!

What’s Next?
We’re already polishing the next major update—expect breathtaking locations, thrilling quests, fearsome bosses, and fresh blueprints! It won’t take as long this time, promise.
Optimization note: We’ve made some experiments with optimization and managed to get some positive results but they are not very visible and if you play with the settings, you can get more fps, but we will keep on working on optimization but it will take more time as we have to concentrate on adding more new content for you to play.
Thank you for being part of this journey! Dive in, explore, and let us know what you think. Happy crafting, adventurers!
— The Magisterium Team
P.S. Found a bug? Let us know—we’re on it!

notes.title: Sneak peek of the upcoming update.
notes.content:
Greetings, dear FantasyCrafters!

We apologize for the lack of news over the past few months. We’ve been working tirelessly on the game, and in fact, we’ve had to rework practically the entire game from scratch. We’ve made numerous changes and added even more content. Now, we’re excited to announce that a major update is on the way.

Warning! Unfortunately, all your current saves will not be compatible with the new update, meaning you’ll have to start the game from the very beginning. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but the previous version of the game didn’t allow us to implement new updates properly, which is why we had to completely overhaul everything. That said, we’ve added so much new content that we believe you’ll find it thrilling to dive into the game all over again.

Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect in the update:

[list]
[*]We’ve expanded the territory where you can build your home and farm. The huge stone fence that once surrounded the area has been removed, and the ore deposits located there have also been cleared (you’ll soon discover why we made these changes).

[*]New locations, caves, and a dungeon have been added, where you’ll uncover new blueprints, resources, and—most importantly—the story of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/17e2121324dedccaf856e4218d41e12d680670ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/fa6d5ad3546f00fab0159a59a68f79ab269c06f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/c3be0957d140761975ac31cbc8589c150984ab62.png[/img]

[*]Animal husbandry has been introduced! You’ll now be able to raise roosters, hens, chickens, cows, bulls, and calves. Hens will lay eggs, which you can either incubate or use in cooking. Cows can give birth to calves and produce milk. You’ll also have access to feeders, animal food, and pens to manage your livestock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/d4e59c112f51360abcc9f7dfed834f16f14c0bfa.gif[/img]

[*]New workbenches, miners, buildings, tools, weapons, and items have been added to the game. We’ve also made some subtle improvements to the interface.

[*]A brand-new and intriguing system has been implemented. Can you guess what it is?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/f3678bcf51b4128e98a5befcc6702769a9f55ee0.gif[/img]
[/list]

We have also added a lot more that you will find in the update.

While we don’t want to make any firm promises, we’re doing our best to release the update by February. If we can’t make it by then, the update will definitely be ready by March.

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to you for sticking with us and for your continued support, even though we haven’t been able to release updates for a long time.

notes.title: News regarding the upcoming update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/3d06932932548d80f4d7db2ccfb7a2da219c961c.png[/img]

Greetings, dear fantasycrafters!
We apologize for not showing up for a long time. We wanted to tell you that we didn’t abandon the game, we kept on working, we have upgraded in-game saving system, added into the game a couple of new workbenches, new items, new locations, new quests, a couple of new mechanics, we have also developed a story of the game. Now we are polishing new content, testing it and we hope that we’ll present you our new content by the New Year.
Stay tuned.

notes.title: Update 0.1.5.01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/ab8bf76fb47fbb668cd7ea502d6ebd99ec2676dc.png[/img]
Greetings, fantasycrafters!

Thank you for your patience as we have promised you in our last post with the Roadmap, we have made some changes in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/594ebc969d74e4f070f0cb3b88ce750f09ef9e5b.png[/img]
Here is a list of things we made:
1) We have totally revamped AI battling system, now the enemy’s behavior became more interesting and complicated: AI animals don’t just constantly attack you, but take their time, can retreat during the battle and even can ran away when it’s few health left. Some complicated AI implement interesting attacks. Small animals like rats, lizards and rabbits have a new complex route of itinerary and now it’s harder to catch them.
2) We have replaced some of AI models to the models with better textures.
3) We have made some corrections in the dialogues with NPCs and added more information into the Journal.
4) We have added some new repeatable quests to NPCs to do your money-making more interesting and diverse.
5) We have added 4 languages: German, French, Portuguese (Brazil variant) and Russian.
6) We have added Server Settings into the game with possibility to kill your Character or your friend’s Character in co-op mode in case you or your friend got stuck or got a bug.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/4144529d954ab6603039a0fbde74062ce6827bfb.jpg[/img]
7) According to your suggestions we have added the possibility - when you have some items on your hotbar like berries, mushrooms, potions and so on, the relevant items you’ll be collecting or picking up will be immediately added to your hotbar and not into your inventory like earlier.
8) We have added sort of items by type in the inventory and in the containers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/8f5e90a7a37ac0dc09e693d817c969514d81fec0.png[/img]
Bugs fixed:
1) Autosave bug was fixed
2) The bug that led to the switch off of the quests on the screen when crosshair was turned off – is fixed
3) Some collisions fixed
4) And some other small issues and bugs fixed

notes.title: Fantasy Craft Roadmap 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/1b8ee2820d47d1796ab9273a79af393e6236a261.png[/img]

Greetings, fantasycrafters!

Lots of you have been asking for a roadmap of the features we are working on. We are sorry for not issuing a new content for some time, as promised, for it turned out to be not that easy and fast to implement everything that we planned.


Take a look at some features you’ll be seeing in the game anytime soon.

1)	New revamped saving system that will give us the opportunity to add new locations, new items, new NPCs and more.
2)	Revamped enemy battle system: we’ve been constantly trying to change the enemy behavior to add more agility, vividness, flexibility to the AI enemy to make them smarter, add variability to their behavior which will make a battle with AI more interesting and will give you an opportunity to make blocks, defending your-self.
[previewyoutube=cYIbsXFCA9I;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=mZLeIF_aOXA;full][/previewyoutube]

3)	We made some corrections in the dialogues with NPCs and in added more information into Journal.
4)	Added more quests to the NPCs.
5)	We are adding more languages in our game. We all know that most of people around the world have great knowledge of English language, but we are quite sure that it’s always more pleasant to play a game on your native language especially when there’s a lot of text involved in the game. We would love to translate our game to all the foreign languages so that everyone could play it, but don’t have such opportunity at the moment. You can suggest your languages in Steam discussions, the language that will get more votes will be added in the game.
6)	Periodically we are planning to add your suggestions into the game from «Suggestions on the game» theme in our Steam Community and from the relevant Chanell in Discord. For example: sort items in the inventory. We will also add a possibility to pick up building part without breaking and losing any of the resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/8f5e90a7a37ac0dc09e693d817c969514d81fec0.png[/img]
7)	We are planning to change some AI models to the ones of a better quality.
8)	Optimization of the game.

Part of the features mentioned above will be included in the upcoming update in May.
Thank you for your support! Stay tuned for the upcoming update.

notes.title: Big Update 0.1.3.05
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings and salutation, adventurers![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/5920ed4f4f6a169ae8f988de639967ec09b5a045.png[/img]
We didn’t publish any new updates for a long time, because we have been working very hard on the game and had to revamp some functions over again. From now onwards, we are going to re-work some systems of the game to improve it. 
[h2]Warning![/h2] When loading your old saves bugs may occur in the form of incorrect display of flora (trees, brushes, plants). It is highly recommended to create a new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/5920ed4f4f6a169ae8f988de639967ec09b5a045.png[/img]
You asked for it and we are happy to present you some furniture and some knickknacks to furnish your house comfortably.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/6eb40ccd269986dbc47bb54b9b398ead0f8a0057.png[/img]
[h3]Here is a list of new blueprints we have added into the game:[/h3]
1. Simple round chair (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
2. Simple rectangular chair (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
3. Round stool (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
4. Small bench (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
5. Rectangular dinner table (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
6. Round dinner table (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
7. Cabinet (buy a blueprint from Eugene) 
8. Bookshelf (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
9. Simple bed (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
10. Simple mattress (buy a blueprint from Gloria)
11. Wooden chandelier (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
12. Iron chandelier (buy a blueprint from Fred)
13. Tall brazier (buy a blueprint from Fred)
14. Small brazier (buy a blueprint from Fred)
15. Deer horn trophy (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
16. Fireplace (buy a blueprint from Fred)
17. Target (buy a blueprint from Eugene)
18. Town’s dark aketon (buy a blueprint from Gloria)
19. Town’s dark breeches (buy a blueprint from Gloria)
20. Town’s dark shoes (buy a blueprint from Gloria)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/f6113af83deb64fc030fa49f64f93f994aca976b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/5920ed4f4f6a169ae8f988de639967ec09b5a045.png[/img]
[h3]Here is a list of things we have added into the game, changed or fixed:[/h3]
• Do you remember those spruces of all sizes around the map? On the whole map of the game, we have substituted these old spruces with the new ones of better quality that look nice and natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/fab325fd60151b19cc1dacf0d1a9421e43dc9dec.png[/img]
• A new item is added into the game: deer horn – you can gather it from a deer.
• Autosave has been added into the game, now you can adjust the time of your autosave press ESC button go to Settings and choose the time of Autosave in the Game settings and Apply. You don’t have be afraid that you lost your progress if you forgot to save. But still don’t forget to save the game if you are implementing a very important mission and save when you exit the game.
• Now you can add stones into the crusher to get sand and limestones. No more tedious digging for sand and mining stones for limestones, just put all the stones you got from your miners and get as much sand and limestones as possible.
• The perfectionists will love it! 😊. We have made building easier and added an option snap to grid. Now during the building, pressing ALT (by default) you can choose 4 sizes of the grid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/b03fb7dce1fceb02e671c6cf88e5def061d57466.png[/img]
• We have changed the weather a lit bit, less overcast now.
• Improved the visual part of the main page of the game (added some good-looking GIFs).
• We have also created a [url=https://discord.gg/AxYUFYrh8j]Discord Channel[/url] to make our communications easier. Add to our discord channel.
• We have re-worked Blueprints tab page.
• Bug, that didn’t allow a client join the game after totally breaking any tool – is fixed.
• Fixed wrong location of compass for non-standard resolutions.
• We have added a description to the requirements Noble Samurai Skill. 
• Added sound during skinning of an animal body.
• We added some small details to the plot of the game to explain some weird things going on outside the village. Newcomers will find a letter close to the skeleton near a small pond not far from Henry’s house. 
• Fixed small bugs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/5920ed4f4f6a169ae8f988de639967ec09b5a045.png[/img]
Now it’s high time for you to earn some money and go blueprints shopping😊.
Furnish your houses and share the pictures of your interior house-designs in the screenshots in our community in Steam and in our [url=https://discord.gg/AxYUFYrh8j]Discord Channel[/url].

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2.3
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!
We have fixed the bug with advanced settings.
We have fixed a bug when server had day while client had night in the game.
We have fixed the bug when the client had sound ambient meant for the day instead of night and visa versa.
We have fixed the bug that didn’t give XP for skinning animals
Now the candles save it’s on and off condition during the game load.
Fixed two holes in the rocks (small cave close to Wolfish Hollow) where a character could fall down and got stuck.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2.2
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!
We have added a new item into the game «simple copper parts». Fred can sell you this blueprint or you can buy/sell simple copper parts from Maximilian. Now if you want to unlock The Damned Place location you will need simple copper parts instead of metal alloy pickaxe heads.

We have increased the volume of water in the crop plot this means that water will stay longer in the crop plot and you don’t have to water your plants very often.
We have increased the spoilage time for all kinds of succusses.
Now when it rains crop plots will be filled with water, if your crop plots are outside.
We have fixed the problem when apple trees didn’t give any seeds.
Unfortunately, the levitating tree has lost it’s magical abilities and came down to earth:).

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!
Happy Wednesday everyone!
Thank you for keep on playing Fantasy Craft, thank you for your positive reviews, thank you for the videos you create we try to watch every video and truly enjoy it, thank you for your suggestions and your feedback on bugs. We wanted to tell you that we are working every day to try to fix some bugs, make some corrections in the game and to bring you some new content, though we can’t publish patches, fixes and updates every day because it takes quite some time to make the game smoother and pleasant for you to play.

Here are some new things we are adding into the game:
1) We have updated the old existing maps and added a map of Lovely-Dale village putting some markets of the main NPC’s there – you can buy it on the market from Maximilian. We have also added an expanded map which you can buy from Pierre. We are quite happy with the maps, hope you will love them too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/de3e7a2082e43d3ed8c3d62d5061c4375e7a4757.png[/img]
2) We have added an additional slot for a compass, a portable lamp and future auxiliary items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/6e65029bb5af5ed7cd5d4e27d6054c27a90da9dc.png[/img]
3) We have also added a compass system so it can easily navigate you in the game. You can buy a compass from Maximilian. Just put a compass into your lower slot.
4) It was a little bit difficult to run in the dark with a small torch in your hands and it restricted your ability to gather resources and fight monsters in the dark, now you can use a Portable lamp that you can put into your additional slot and have your hands free to do whatever you want. Portable lamp can be crafted in the carpenter’s bench, you need to buy a blueprint from Eugene. Portable lamp uses oil as a fuel. Just add a portable lamp into your lower slot.
5) Oil can be produced in Fluid press from wheat seeds and corn seeds and use a simple vial to fill it will oil. Make sure you craft a lot of oil and take it with you if you’re going a long way from home.
6) You’ve asked to do something so you could carry a lot of heavy stuff like wood, stones and so on, so we have created a Mule’s bag where you can heavy a lot of heavy stuff for example if you want to build a house and need a lot of wood inside your bag. You can craft a mule’s bag in thew tailor’s bench, just buy a blueprint from Gloria. Mule’s bag increases your weight per 500, but doesn’t give additional slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/bda2073f1fdd0f86cc833473100a6a913bae040f.png[/img]
7) New metal alloy has been added in the game. Now you can craft metal alloy ingots in the smelt-furnace using iron, copper and sulfur powder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/9a4960f66bb64f629d6aed595749831b39e5c130.png[/img]


Corrections made in the game:
1) Copper hatchet and copper pickaxe are substituted with metal alloy hatchet and pickaxe.
2) Now when you come to NPC to start trading, you will be able to see a green check mark of the blueprint that you’ve bought and learned.
3) A quest for a crusher and a quest for a coal, iron and copper miners were swapped around, for we thought that it would make sense to get a crusher first and then coal, iron and copper miners. For those of you who have come that far and didn’t get a crusher can buy coal, iron and copper miners from Estiel after completing all his quests.
4) Now you can get XP for skinning animals with a knife.
5) Ice melts longer
6) We have increased the time of food spoilage.
7) Weather has been edited a little bit.
8) The recipe for the advanced wooden chest has been corrected, now you can use wooden planks instead of treated ones.
9) Firewood burning time has been increased in standing torches and wall torches.
10) Now you can use coal in advanced standing torches.
11) Edited the price for raw meat and fish.
12) The quantity of wooden plates and cups crafted from one small blocking lumber has been increased.
13) The description of Proficient Woodcutter and Crafty mine-digger has been edited.
14) Corrected the weight of a simple blade and a long blade
15) Increased the crafting time for iron arrows.
16) Heavy Hand 2 corrected in skills.
17) Corrected some collisions in the Ruins location.
18) Fixed the problem of repeated crafting of Montanus Salus recipe.
19) Reduced the quantity of iron ingots used to craft an iron
chest.
20) Added lamps in Estiel’s room so you could find him in the dark.
21) Made some text changes in some quests.

Bugs fixed:
• Fixed the problem when you couldn’t put your workbenches and chests on other floors other than the first floor of your house.
• Fixed (with the help of RMB) the quick transfer of items to a hot bar to increase the quantity of items infinitely.
• Partially fixed an issue when some players had empty chests in different locations or had a changing quantity of slots in some workbenches. This won’t appear in a new created game, but we are going to revamp a loading system in the future to eliminate the future bugs.
• Fixed the problem when in all the locked chests displayed only one difficulty level «Beginner», although there were various chests with three difficulty levels of lockpicking.
• Fixed again the problem connected with day/night cycle settings not saving (we hope).
• Landscape bugs fixed.
• And some other small issues fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Happy Thanksgiving Day!
In this hotfix we just made some small corrections:
• We fixed Advanced settings that didn’t save after exiting the game
• Changed the carcass to a large one that you get from a wild boar when cutting with an iron skinning knife
• Made some small changes in quests texts

notes.title: Patch 0.1.14
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
We wanted to tell you that see and read all your suggestions and bugs reports. We try to fix the small bugs in the game, some bugs seem to need more time to be fixed. We will do our best to realize your suggestions, but it may take some time.
In this patch we added a wall torch to bring some light into your houses. You can buy a blueprint of a wall torch at Eugene’s and craft it in the carpenter’s bench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/58817f7792d351365a7e490969710b1c2fe45408.png[/img]
Here is a list of things we corrected/fixed:
• We have fixed environment sounds, that didn’t react to changing in the settings.
• You can move your work stations/containers with the help of a mallet without breaking them. Just make sure you take all the stuff out of your work station/container before picking it up. Work stations/container should be fully repaired before you pick them up (otherwise it would be a lifehack on a free repair:)). This option is not applicable to campfires and primitive standing torch, because they are self-destructive. You can’t pick-up the building part not to make the game too casual (easy).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/45e5dd67ef555021b501611719fa17098d3066c3.png[/img]
• We took out the function to sell things by clicking the right mouse so you wouldn’t be able to accidentally buy an unnecessary blueprint.
• We added to traders the possibility to buy the following things: lime carbonate, primitive bow, stone hatchet, stone pickaxe, stone shovel, primitive tool/weapon/equipment repair kits, bandages, ash. Now you can also sell the building parts to Eugene and make good money.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.13
notes.content:
Dear adventurers!
We have added advanced settings into the current game (save). Now any moment of the game you can change hunger/thirst settings and day/night settings.
Please be advised, that the players who are going to load a game with new settings, your settings will reset to default settings, so when you load your game, please adjust your settings the way you want and then save the game again.
We have also added/corrected/fixed the following things:
• Corrected ice fruit tea recipe
• Added more quartz in Ruins location
• Added containers in Ruined Village in Ruins location
• Added an option to show/hide hotbar and crosshair
• Added the blueprints, which are given by NPC for completing quests in case somebody loses the blueprint
• Fixed the possibility to sell all the items to all traders by clicking RMB
• Added an option that gives an opportunity to choose the quantity of items per 10 when selling/buying things
• Fixed collision of some rocks
• Fixed the house the player got stuck in the Ruined Village in Ruins location
• Now you can put primitive torch anywhere you like
• Corrected landscape
• Fixed small insignificant details

notes.title: Community Patch 0.1.12
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!
Happy Friday everyone!
We would like to thank each and every one of you who bought our game, plays it and supports us in our community, thanks to all the content makers for creating interesting and funny videos playing our game, thanks to all who leave positive reviews on Steam, inspiring us!
We would like to tell you that we see all your comments, suggestions, questions and we try to pay attention to everyone and to answer all your questions as soon as possible.
Many of you asked us to alleviate the survival element in the game, we heard you and added some corrections.

We added:
• Food and water settings
• Day/Night settings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/6d95faffabfa5cd528024b4fb75e092fa6cb7bb1.png[/img]

• Mouse settings
• Weather volume
• Reset button to default in Graphic settings
• We decreased the prices for some blueprints (lockpicks, chests, fisherman’s workbench, baits, larva silk/spider silk)
• Decreased the time of water replenish in the wells (now the water in the wells replenish in 15 minutes)
• Automatic switch-off

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/4f65edd6874cb9b216f7fbafdffa079ac52f3109.png[/img]

Bugs fixed:
• Dryer’s collision fixed
• Fixed the issue with the top roof
• Damage fall taken
• Landscape bugs fixed
• And some other fixed

This is all for now.
We wanted to tell you that our artist is working on a large detailed general map of the world and a couple of locals maps, we are also working on a compass system so you could easily find your way home.

Thank you all for your patience and for your support. Great thanks to the community for sharing tips on the game and helping each other to make progress, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Fantasy Craft early access release with 21% discount!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Fantasy Craft is now available for you survive, explore and craft! Play alone or with your friends and have some fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010291/8c3f805d8dd51bde8656d7c3979d7d1a0d61f7df.png[/img]

What is available in the game for now:
●Big map to play the game for a few hours
●Alternation of day and night and weather changes
●Choose the profession you want to progress in: a blacksmith, a carpenter, a hunter, a cook, a tailor, an alchemist
●Interact with NPC, carry out some NPC's quests to open the access to new knowledge
●Interact with traders on the market: sell and buy stuff
●Cut trees, mine
●Eat and drink to survive
●Hunt animals, learn how to сut them to get more meat
●Go fishing
●Learn how to cook sophisticated food to have a full belly
●Gather berries, mushrooms, flowers and learn how to make potions
●Research all the plants you find in order to open recipes they are used in
●Learn how to process the wood
●Master the metals
●Learn how to process the animal's skin and make clothing
●Build your own house
●Expand your land, buying more land plots with coal, iron and copper ores
●Craft various workbenches
●Craft things and sell to NPC's and traders to get more gold
●Level up your skills
●Buy new recipes to craft more new stuff to sell to get more money
●Get some scarse resources and learn how to use them
●Fight the enemies
●Find the secret caves
●Find treasures
●Buy lockpicks to open chests and cupboards
●Play with your friends!

notes.content: Hello everyone! We have wonderful news to share with you the early access release date is November 13, 2023! Sales for the game will be 21% and it will last a week.
